news.title: Microsoft plans first-ever voluntary employee buyout for up to 7% of U.S. workforce
news.description: Microsoft's inaugural voluntary buyouts will be open to workers at the senior director level and below whose years of employment and age add up to 70 or more.

news.title: Meta will cut 10% of workforce as company pushes deeper into AI
news.description: Meta plans to lay off 10% of its workforce, equaling about 8,000 employees, as the company continues to ramp up investments in artificial intelligence.

news.title: Brent oil tops $104 per barrel on unconfirmed report Iran's top negotiator resigned
news.description: Oil prices are rising again as tensions escalate in the U.S.-Iran conflict.
